T-CASE-0.initial: Power off, empty cooled reservoir, cover removed.
T-CASE-0.action: Place diffuser tray and selected rack; replace cover and remove it; lift rack vertically.
T-CASE-0.observable: Support contacts, cover seating and access clearance.
T-CASE-0.pass_condition: Tray and rack support within 1 mm of independent reference datum; no unintended penetration >0.2 mm; cover and rack removable without collision. Missing true support geometry blocks this check.
T-CASE-0.note: Benchmark test tolerances and event timing, not manufacturer thermal or physical performance.

T-CASE-1.initial: Procedure monitor with empty unpowered bath; geometry-based fluid level markers, not fluid dynamics.
T-CASE-1.action: Exercise valid 30 mm depth/30 mm freeboard; negative 20 mm depth and 20 mm freeboard cases; request drain while powered or 60 C, then retry unplugged at 35 C.
T-CASE-1.observable: Independent procedure-validity state and body pour access.
T-CASE-1.pass_condition: Only fill states satisfying both 25.4 mm limits are accepted; unsafe drain requests flagged invalid; unplugged 35 C pour sequence allowed. Monitor decisions are B procedure checks, not claimed automatic device interlocks.
T-CASE-1.note: Benchmark test tolerances and event timing, not manufacturer thermal or physical performance.

T-CASE-2.initial: Water mode, protection enabled, saved setpoint 37 C; independent fault injection.
T-CASE-2.action: Enter 40 C and cancel; enter 45 C and wait 31 s; save 40 C; start heating and inject low-fluid fault.
T-CASE-2.pass_condition: Cancel/timeout preserve 37 C; save commits 40 C; low-fluid fault disables heat within 1 s and exposes error state. No inferred trip height or measured thermal response.
T-CASE-2.note: Benchmark test tolerances and event timing, not manufacturer thermal or physical performance.

T-LOAD.condition: No errors, resources resolved and all states finite.
